title: epan: Add a user name column and pinfo field
description:
Add a common user name column and pinfo field and use it in the Falco
events and Procmon dissectors.

Use "%U" for the column abbreviation. It was previously used for
COL_COS_VALUE (vlan.priority) but that was deprecated in 2009.

notes.body: added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 2
